    t1 = Text("\tStyled", style="red")

    # "Hello" (red) + "\t" (red) + "World" (blue)
    t2 = Text("Hello\tWorld", style="red")
    t2.stylize("World", style="blue")
    # "Hello" is 5 chars. Pos 5. tab_size 8.
    # 8 - (5 % 8) = 3 spaces.
    # Total length = 5 + 3 + 5 = 13.
    t2.expand_tabs(tab_size=8)
    assert len(t2) == 13

    # 8-13: blue (World)

    assert t2._spans[0].end == 8

    assert t2._spans[1].end == 13

from rich.text import Text
from rich.style import Style

def test_expand_tabs_styling():
    # Case 1: Simple tab with overall style
    t = Text("\tStyled", style="red")
    t.expand_tabs(tab_size=8)
    # Tab at the beginning: 8 spaces + "Styled" = 14 chars.
    # All should be red.
    assert len(t) == 14
    # The whole thing should be one red span from 0 to 14
    assert len(t._spans) == 1
    assert t._spans[0].start == 0
    assert t._spans[0].end == 14
    assert str(t._spans[0].style) == "red"

    # Case 2: Tab inside a specific span
    t = Text("Hello\tWorld")
    t.stylize("Hello\t", style="red")
    t.stylize("World", style="blue")
    # "Hello" (5) + "\t" (1) + "World" (5) = 11
    # Tab is at index 5. Tab size 8.
    # 8 - (5 % 8) = 3 spaces.
    # Result: "Hello" + "   " + "World" = 5 + 3 + 5 = 13 characters.
    t.expand_tabs(tab_size=8)
    assert len(t) == 13
    # We expect "Hello   " to be red and "World" to be blue.
    # Span 1: (0, 8, red), Span 2: (8, 13, blue)
    assert len(t._spans) == 2
    assert t._spans[0].start == 0
    assert t._spans[0].end == 8
    assert str(t._spans[0].style) == "red"
    assert t._spans[1].start == 8
    assert t._spans[1].end == 13
    assert str(t._spans[1].style) == "blue"

    # Case 3: Tab at the end of a line
    t = Text("Hello\t", style="red")
    t.expand_tabs(tab_size=8)
    # 5 + 3 = 8 spaces.
    assert len(t) == 8
    assert len(t._spans) == 1
    assert t._spans[0].end == 8

    # Case 4: Multiple tabs
    t = Text("\t\t", style="green")
    t.expand_tabs(tab_size=8)
    # 8 + 8 = 16
    assert len(t) == 16
    assert len(t._spans) == 1
    assert t._spans[0].end == 16

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        test_expand_tabs_styling()
        print("All tests passed!")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Test failed! {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
